create_agent_progress_tracker: create an AgentProgress instance to track and display progress of multiple agents in a rich terminal table
run_agent_status_updates: run agent status updates with agent name, ticker, status text, and optional analysis via update_status
register_status_handler: register a callback handler that receives agent name, ticker, status, analysis, and timestamp on each update
get_all_agent_status: get all agent statuses as a dictionary with ticker, status, and display name for each agent
start_stop_progress_display: start and stop the live rich progress display with refresh_per_second=4 for agent status updates
